title: margin.
description: A lightweight, client-side Markdown viewer. Drop in a .md file or open one by URL and read it with clean typography, syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, and an auto table of contents. Nothing you open ever leaves your device — there is no backend.

title: Z.AI MCP Extensions for Zed
description: Zed extensions that wrap the Z.AI MCP servers so the Zed Agent can use the tools without depending on remote MCP connections that kept failing in day-to-day use.

title: Zed Extension Development Skill
description: A Claude/Codex-style skill that captures the repeatable parts of building Zed MCP extensions, from extension structure and manifest details to testing loops.

title: My Bus Assistant
description: A fast Singapore bus-arrival web app with real-time data, smart search, favorites, nearby stops, and offline-friendly caching.

title: Home Grimoire
description: A local-first iOS assistant for home appliance manuals, exploring on-device AI, manual retrieval, and more reliable ways to answer practical questions at home.

title: React Breakthrough
description: A digital version of the abstract strategy game Breakthrough with drag-and-drop gameplay, board customization, themes, and responsive UX.
